title: Prompt Payment Standard: Late Settlement Addition to Death Claim Interest on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
An addition to the rate of death claim interest applies when an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities death benefit share is paid long after the death claim was approved.

## Standard

The late settlement addition is **2% (0.02)** where payment is made more than **30** days after the death claim was approved and the contract was issued in one of **FL, GA or TX**, **1% (0.01)** where payment is made more than 30 days after approval and the contract was issued in any other state, and nothing otherwise. The addition is made to the claim interest base rate.

The approval date is the decision date recorded on the death claim; days are calendar days from it to the payment date; the state of issue is the one on the contract record.

## Matrix

| Days from approval to payment | State of issue | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | Any | Nothing |
| More than 30 | FL, GA or TX | 2% |
| More than 30 | Any other state | 1% |

## Worked cases (hypothetical, death claim approved 2 May)

| Payment date | Days after approval | State of issue | Addition |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 June | 30 | TX | Nothing |
| 2 June | 31 | TX | 2% |
| 2 June | 31 | PA | 1% |
